# Proposed Future Skills

This repository uses VS Code Copilot customization files, but it does not define custom skill workflows yet.

If the team later wants repo-scoped skills, these are the most useful candidates:

- app-shell scaffolding for sidebar, topbar, and dashboard layout composition
- RTK Query domain API generation for demand, supply, tariff, carbon, and account modules
- ECharts widget scaffolding using the shared token palette and chart registry
- responsive/tablet review for dashboard screens
- AI assistant panel rendering and response-shape validation

Add real skills only after confirming the exact supported skill file format and review workflow for this workspace.
